main.description: Discover what it's like to live life on wheels and become part of this story alongside the best competitors in the world.

description.paragraph1: Skateboarding was born as a creative alternative for surfers looking for new ways to experience freedom on wheels. Every trick, every street, and every generation has helped shape the story of this ever-evolving culture.
description.paragraph2: Discover how skateboarding began, evolved, and became a global cultural movement. Click to explore the complete journey that transformed skateboarding into a worldwide icon.

description.subtitle: Meet the athletes who have been making history in skateboarding.
description.paragraph: Discover the journeys of the athletes who are leaving their mark on the sport through talent, attitude, and constant growth. Explore their achievements, unique styles, and the impact they have both on and off the skatepark.

description.paragraph1: Curated playlists to accompany your skate sessions, training, and everyday rides.
description.paragraph2: A selection of tracks designed to get you into the skateboarding mindset with powerful beats and plenty of energy made for those who live and breathe skateboarding.

about.title: About
about.description: Discover the history of skateboarding, its evolution, and how it became a cultural movement that inspires generations.

origin.paragraph1: Skateboarding originated in California, United States, during the 1960s. It was invented by surfers as a way to have fun on days when there were no waves.
origin.paragraph3: By 1965, the first skateboards were manufactured and the first competitions were held.

tonyHawk.paragraph1: The sport gained worldwide popularity in the 1990s when Tony Hawk revolutionized skateboarding with his aerials and flips.
tonyHawk.paragraph2: Tony Hawk is still considered the greatest skateboarder of all time.

culture.paragraph1: Skateboarding is practiced on streets all around the world and in dedicated places such as skate parks.

competition.paragraph1: In competitions, there are two main categories: Street and Half Pipe.
competition.paragraph2: Tricks are judged based on difficulty, execution, and overall performance.

athletes.title: Athletes
athletes.description: Meet the skaters who shaped the scene, from the legends to the new generation transforming the sport.

championships.title: Championships
championships.description: Explore major skate championships and follow the athletes making history in the park and on the street.

LegacyStreetTour.title: Legacy Street Tour
LegacyStreetTour.subtitle: Where the world's best skaters go head-to-head.
LegacyStreetTour.description: Discover the Legacy Street Tour, the championship bringing together skill, style, and raw adrenaline. Click to learn more about past editions and the athletes making history.

BoardwalkClash.title: Boardwalk Clash
BoardwalkClash.subtitle: Where adrenaline meets the street and the park.
BoardwalkClash.description: Explore the Boardwalk Clash, one of the most exciting events in global skateboarding, featuring high-impact tricks and elite athletes. Click to discover previous editions and key highlights.

StreetWomensPro.title: Street Women's Pro
StreetWomensPro.subtitle: Where the impossible becomes reality.
StreetWomensPro.description: Discover the Street Women's Pro, the event pushing limits and celebrating the boldest skaters on the planet. Click to watch legendary moments and historic achievements.

OldSchoolStreetPro.title: Old School Street Pro
OldSchoolStreetPro.subtitle: The park is the stage for creativity.
OldSchoolStreetPro.description: Check out the Old School Street Pro, the championship showcasing technique, style, and innovation on every course. Click to follow the athletes and trendsetting performances.

footer.description: More than a sport, skateboarding represents freedom, creativity, and self-expression in every detail.
